## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8bd04be9d8d593c1bce017a9b644778ce82508af`

Read for this review: card objectui#10559 (body and its 3 comments; the os-dev-report's claims were NOT used as evidence), the triage note (comment 5831188116), the claim (comment 5831903741), the cited card objectui#10487 and PRs objectui#10557 / objectui#10590, PR objectui#10629's body, file list and check-runs, AGENTS.md (版本号策略 and the changeset-presence rule under Housekeeping), `.changeset/config.json`, and the code via `git show refs/review/pr-10629:PATH` diffed against the merge-base `b1030c71a617c4507e5d220319b728ebf367baf1`. The shared working tree has no `node_modules`, so the pin was judged by reading, not by running. Two commits on the branch: `d8f2ce1` (the fix) and `8bd04be` (merge of `origin/main` at `b1030c7`). Diff: 3 files, +358 / −58; `LookupField.tsx` modified (+92 / −58), the pin and the changeset added. No import or export line moves.

### ① Derived judgments

Binding text. Triage (5831188116): 「objectui#10557's shape (keep the picked row, derive the option on render); region order after PR objectui#10557 in the same file.」 Claim (5831903741): 「the picked ROW is kept, and the chip's option is derived from it through the same resolver on render … ⛔ Not a cached option frozen at pick time, and ⛔ not a remount.」 and 「The browse-all dialog path (`handlePickerSelectRecords`) is measured too, and fixed the same way if it has the same defect.」 and the surface 「⛔ not the `RecordPickerDialog` JSX props, which this seat's PR objectui#10590 edits」.

1. Cache holds rows, not options — RIGHT. `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx:304-311` at head: `pickerResolvedRecords` (an array of `LookupOption`) is replaced by `pickedRecords`, an array of row objects, the same shape as `hydratedRecords`. `git grep pickerResolvedRecords` over the whole head tree returns nothing, so no stale reader is left.

2. One derivation, one memo, no second copy — RIGHT. `LookupField.tsx:873-885`: the memo PR objectui#10557 introduced for `hydratedOptions` now returns the tuple `[pickedOptions, hydratedOptions]`; one `toOption` closure calls `recordToOption(r, declaredDisplayField, idField, effectiveDescriptionField, refObjectSchema, readable)` for both arrays; the deps list (`pickedRecords, hydratedRecords, declaredDisplayField, idField, effectiveDescriptionField, refObjectSchema, perms, referenceTo`) names everything the closure reads. Those are the same inputs `fetchedOptions` uses at `LookupField.tsx:717-726`. No new `useEffect` and no `key=` appears anywhere in the diff, so there is no relabel effect and no remount. This is exactly objectui#10557's shape, reused rather than copied.

3. `findOption` / `findOptionLoose` order preserved — RIGHT. `LookupField.tsx:895` and `:912` read `pickedOptions` in the third slot, where `pickerResolvedRecords` sat; static, fetched, picked, hydrated, unchanged. The hydration effect's `unresolved` filter at `:801`, which drops every id `findOption` already resolves, is untouched, so a kept pick still suppresses the fetch (the pin's `findOne` assertion rests on this).

4. Dropdown pick keeps the served row — RIGHT, and the "same row `fetchedOptions` builds from" claim checks out. `LookupField.tsx:1168-1174` `handleSelectCandidate` looks the option's value up in `previewRows` (`:1154-1162`, keyed by `String(v)` with the same `idField / id / _id / externalId` chain `recordValue` uses at `:185-187`) and hands `toPredicateRecord(served, refObjectSchema?.fields)` to `handleSelect`. `fetchedOptions` (`:717-726`) and `recentOptions` (`:1131-1140`) both build from `toPredicateRecord(r, refObjectSchema?.fields)`, so the kept row is the one the dropdown labelled. Both dropdown commit sites go through it: the option `onClick` at `:1654` and the Enter key at `:1311` (deps `:1315`). `handleSelect` at `:1012-1016` keeps the row only when one is handed (`if (row && option && option.value != null)`), merging by `mergeRowsByValue(prev, [row], idField)`; `idField` is added to its deps at `:1036`, which is correct since the callback now reads it. A static (authored) option has no `previewRows` entry, so nothing is kept for it (see item 9).

5. Browse-all dialog and people picker: measured, same defect, fixed the same way — RIGHT. Base `handlePickerSelectRecords` built options with the `refObjectSchema` of the render it ran in and wrote them to the cache; head `LookupField.tsx:1052-1059` writes the rows the pickers hand back (`setPickedRecords(records)`) and pushes recents by `recordValue(r, idField)`, the same value the old `o.value` carried. Both pickers hand row arrays: `RecordPickerDialog.tsx:807` (`onSelectRecords?.([selected])`, single) and `:822` (multi), with the dialog collapsing relations itself per its own doc at `:561-565`; `PeoplePicker.tsx:332` and `:343`. Both declare the prop as a function whose one parameter is `records: any[]`, so the narrowed handler parameter type is assignable. The replace-not-merge semantics are unchanged from base (`setPickerResolvedRecords(mapped)` also replaced). Deps shrink to `[idField, referenceTo]`, which is all the callback reads now.

6. `RecordPickerDialog` JSX props untouched — RIGHT. The diff's hunks are at head lines 185, 301, 847, 870, 892, 909, 993, 1033, 1045, 1147, 1161, 1224, 1240, 1308 and 1651; the `PeoplePicker` element (`LookupField.tsx:1518-1537`) and the `RecordPickerDialog` element (`:1752-1775`) are outside every hunk, and `onSelectRecords={handlePickerSelectRecords}` at `:1534` and `:1769` is the same identifier as before. PR objectui#10590's `displayField={declaredDisplayField}` / `objectSchema={refObjectSchema}` lines at `:1763-1764` are intact.

7. Quick-create cache write — necessary and behaviour-neutral where it claims to be. Base called `setPickerResolvedRecords` to prepend `opt` ahead of the filtered previous cache, then `handleSelect(opt)`, which cached the same option again; head `LookupField.tsx:1227` and `:1243` call `handleSelect(opt, result.data)` / `handleSelect(opt, created)` and the separate prepend is gone. Necessary: the state it wrote no longer exists, and quick-create is a writer of "the cached-option state they write" named in the claim's surface. Neutral: the cache is keyed by value and `findOption` uses `.find`, so prepend-vs-append order was never observable. Not neutral, and correctly disclosed: the created record is now relabelled by the schema (the pin's row 3), which the card's design note ("how quick-create … fit") asked to be decided.

8. `mergeRowsByValue` helper — necessary enough and behaviour-neutral. `LookupField.tsx:188-203` is a 1:1 lift of the inline `new Map(prev.map(...)); for (...) map.set(...); Array.from(map.values())` the hydration effect had; the effect at `:850` now calls it with identical arguments. Two callers now exist (`:850`, `:1015`), so the factor avoids a second copy of the merge. Outside the claim's three named functions, but disclosed in the PR body and harmless.

9. Authored static options no longer cached — a disclosed behaviour change, judged acceptable. Base cached a picked static option in `pickerResolvedRecords`; head keeps nothing for it (`handleSelectCandidate` finds no served row, `handleSelect` keeps nothing without a row). `findOption` reads `staticOptions` first (`:893`), so the chip resolves on every render while the option is authored. The one divergence, an option removed from the authored list after its pick, now yields no chip because `selectedOptions` at `:986-988` filters unresolved values out; before, a stale label showed. That is a correction, not a guard weakened: no existing test pins the stale behaviour (checked the fields suite under `git grep`), and the triage's design note explicitly left static options to this design step.

10. `onSelectRecord` contract unchanged — RIGHT. `LookupField.tsx:1031` still hands the host the option that was picked; the row is not passed outward.

11. Missing asks — none found. Dropdown path fixed, dialog path measured and fixed, quick-create decided, changeset present, pin beside the existing `LookupField.*.test.tsx` files, branch merged `origin/main` after PR objectui#10590 landed (the merge commit `8bd04be` has parent `b1030c7`).

12. Done but not asked — the hydration merge refactor (item 8), one added sentence in the `previewRows` doc at `:1150-1152`, the `handleSelect` comment rewritten as a JSDoc block at `:996-1011` (the #2150 rationale is preserved), the parameter type of `handlePickerSelectRecords` narrowed from `any[]` to row objects, and two pin rows (quick-create, and a second control) beyond the claim's pin shape. All additive or neutral; none touches a published surface.

13. Existing pins edited or deleted — none. The diff adds two files and edits one source file; no test file is modified.

14. The new pin `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.pickedLabel-10559.test.tsx` can fail. Its order is forced, not raced: `makeBackend` (`:59-86`) holds `getObjectSchema` on a promise released only by the test, and every row first asserts the no-schema label (`toEqual(['Acme'])` at `:170` and `:191`, `['Globex']` at `:211`) BEFORE releasing, so a schema that resolved early cannot make the row pass vacuously. Negative legs: `not.toContain('Acme')` at `:174` and `:195`, `not.toContain('Globex')` at `:215`, and `expect(ds.findOne).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` at `:176` and `:196`, which rejects a relabel-by-refetch implementation. Lit controls: row 4 (`:218-228`, pick after the schema reads `HT-001` at once) and row 5 (`:230-242`, dropdown option and chip agree). Red on the merge-base by reading: base `handleSelect` cached the option built from `fetchedOptions` with `refObjectSchema` undefined (label `Acme` from `shown['name']`), the popover closed so `fetchedOptions` emptied, `findOption('c1')` then hit `pickerResolvedRecords` for good and the hydration effect returned early, so `toEqual(['HT-001'])` fails; the dialog and quick-create rows fail the same way through `handlePickerSelectRecords`'s and quick-create's own `recordToOption` calls with no schema. Every fixture row carries a `name` value, so the `name` guess and the `nameField` answer differ on every row. `chipLabels()` reads `aria-label` built by `t('lookup.remove', { label })`, whose default is `'Remove {{label}}'` (`useFieldTranslation.ts:27`), matching the `/^Remove /` regex.

### ② Semver level

- Level: `patch` for `@object-ui/fields`, declared in `.changeset/10559-picked-lookup-relabels.md`. `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` is published executable source of a package in the `fixed` group of `.changeset/config.json`, so AGENTS.md's Housekeeping rule requires a changeset; this is a bug fix with no export, prop or accept-set change, so `patch` is the right level; not `major` (banned by 版本号策略) and not empty-frontmatter (this is not docs-only; `content/docs/**` is untouched). Correct.
- Changeset prose, sentence by sentence against the diff:
  - "A pick used to cache the option it was handed, with its label built at pick time." TRUE (base `setPickerResolvedRecords` in `handleSelect`).
  - "A lookup asks for the referenced object's schema when it mounts, so a record picked before that schema arrived was labelled on the `name` guess, and the chip kept that label." TRUE (`recordToOption` rung 2 without `objectDef`; cache never re-derived).
  - "The dropdown option for the same record read the object's declared `nameField` once the schema arrived." TRUE (`fetchedOptions` is a memo on `refObjectSchema`).
  - "So the chip read `Acme` while its own dropdown option read `HT-001`." TRUE for the fixture the pin encodes.
  - "This held for a pick from the dropdown, from the browse-all dialog and from quick-create." TRUE (three base cache writers, each with the render-time schema).
  - "A pick now keeps the record's row instead of the option." TRUE (`pickedRecords`).
  - "The chip's option is derived from that row on every render, through the same derivation the hydrated value uses since objectui#10487, so its label follows the schema when it arrives." TRUE (one memo at head `:880-885`).
  - "The row a dropdown pick keeps is the candidate as served, with relations collapsed to ids, as the dropdown builds its options." TRUE (`handleSelectCandidate` and `fetchedOptions` both apply `toPredicateRecord`).
  - "The browse-all dialog and the search-first people picker keep the rows they hand back, and quick-create keeps the created record." TRUE (`:1057`, `:1227`, `:1243`).
  - "No record is fetched again to relabel it, and no remount is involved." TRUE (no new effect, no `key=`; the pin asserts `findOne` unused).
  - "An authored static option keeps no row: its chip resolves from the authored `options` list, which is consulted first." TRUE (`findOption` rank 1 is `staticOptions`).
- Docs / README prose added by the diff: none (no `content/docs/**` or README file is touched). The in-source comments added were read and match the code they describe.

### ③ Boundary flags

- PR body flags answered. (a) "a picked static option is no longer cached … Now it shows no chip": verified, see ① item 9; acceptable. (b) "multi-select browse-all confirm … replaces the kept picks … already the case": verified against base, the base wrote `setPickerResolvedRecords(mapped)` too. (c) "the search-first people picker shares `handlePickerSelectRecords`": verified at `LookupField.tsx:1534`; no pin of its own, and none was asked. (d) the objectui#10487 pin's comment "the chip reads the option the pick cached" (`LookupField.hydratedLabel-10487.test.tsx:259`) is now loose wording; the assertion is unaffected and the file is outside the claimed surface, so leaving it is correct. (e) "`origin/main` moved after this branch's merge": confirmed, see the last flag. No open questions are listed in the PR body.
- CI at head `8bd04be9d8d593c1bce017a9b644778ce82508af`, three polls a few minutes apart. Poll 1: 42 check-runs, 28 success, 3 skipped, 11 in progress. Poll 2: 42, 37 success, 3 skipped, 2 in progress (`Test (shard 4/8)`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`). Poll 3 (final): 43 check-runs, 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 in progress, 0 failure, 0 cancelled. The 3 skipped are `Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)` and `dependabot`, matrix placeholders and the dependabot no-op. Every run that executed is green.
- Draft: YES, the PR is a draft (`draft: true`).
- `Clause-②: no` holds.
